classification: NON-PRODUCTION qualification of the Aux5 successor producer; certificates produced here are not production cells and are never composed into a production ledger

isolation.process: each run is a fresh interpreter started with env -i and the frozen thread contract; no shared state, no resume (--skip-if-current NOT used)
isolation.outputs: distinct output file per run under qualification/<run_label>/
isolation.checkout: clean git checkout of the freeze commit; the manifest v3 initial and final gates must pass
isolation.shape: the 4 runs execute concurrently, pinned to distinct physical cores (logical cpus 0,2,4,6): the Aux4 measured cost shape (one worker per physical core)

pass_criteria.P1_runs_complete: all 4 runs exit 0; final gate stage == final; provenance_chain.all_verified; scipy_guard.scipy_free
pass_criteria.P2_determinism_scientific_hash: per cell, scientific_content_hash identical across its 2 repeats
pass_criteria.P3_determinism_certificates: per cell, every certificates.*.certificate_hash identical across its 2 repeats
pass_criteria.P4_runtime_binding: every record's runtime_contract_hash and producer_identity_hash equal the frozen manifest v3 identity
pass_criteria.P5_backend_repair: every record's producer.runtime.backend_libraries is non-empty and contains the four required families by absolute path
pass_criteria.verdict: PASS iff P1-P5 all hold; otherwise FAIL (no retry, no tolerance)

measurements.c_max: max over the 4 runs of cpu_seconds_including_dependencies (CPU-s)

cap: recompute CAP with config/COST_CAP_FORMULA.json using the measured c_max, N = 326, W = 4
informational_only: scientific_content_hash equality with the Aux4 SkylakeX records of cells 318/323 (expected unequal: different kernel and identity); never a criterion; obligation statuses are not interpreted

transition_to_production.rule: qualification certificates are NOT the first production cells. Production of any of the 326 cells requires a separate frozen production checkpoint (ledger, lifecycle, cap invariant, K4 integrity attestation).
